definitions.short: Jachaziel , the name of five Israelites
definitions.full: H3166. Yachaziel יַחֲזִיאֵל proper name, masculine ( El sees ) — 1 Benjamite warrior of David 1Chr 12:4 . 2 priest of David 1Chr 16:6 . 3 a Levite 1Chr 23:19 ; 24:23 . 4 a Levite of the sons of Asaph 2Chr 20:14 . 5 ancestor of one of the families of the restoration Ezra 8:5 .
